test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 15 hours and 12 hours, respectively. Pipe C alone can empty the full tank in 10 hours. If all the three pipes are opened together for 2 hours 40 minutes, then what part of the tank will remain unfilled?
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A can fill a tank = 15 hours

Pipe B can fill a tank = 12 hours

Pipe C alone can empty the full tank = 10 hours

All the three pipes are opened together for 2 hours 40 minutes

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 15, 12 and 10 is 60

Efficiency of Pipe A = (60/15) = 4

Efficiency of Pipe B = (60/12) = 5

Efficiency of Pipe C = (60/10) = 6

Now,

All the three pipes are opened together = [(4 + 5) – 6]

⇒ (9 – 6) = 3

All the three pipes are opened together for 2 hour 40 min = [(120 + 40)/60 × 3] = (160/60 × 3)

⇒ 8 hours

The remaining part of the tank unfilled = (60 – 8)/60

⇒ (52/60)

⇒ 13/15

**∴ The required** **value is 13over15**
